name: South Africa

eSignLaw.name: Electronic Communications and Transactions Act 25 of 2002

levelNote: An electronic signature is not without legal force only because it is electronic. Where the law requires a signature and the parties have not agreed otherwise, an advanced electronic signature may be needed.

formRequirements.note: Wills are excluded from the ECTA.
Sales and long-term leases of land are excluded from the ECTA and need a signed written document.

notices: Electronic signature law that applies: Electronic Communications and Transactions Act 25 of 2002. An electronic signature is not without legal force only because it is electronic. Where the law requires a signature and the parties have not agreed otherwise, an advanced electronic signature may be needed.
You must be at least 18 years old to sign this agreement.
If you are unsure whether this applies to you, ask for a paper alternative before signing.
limitationNote: General prescription period: three years (Prescription Act 68 of 1969, section 11).
